equity_bridge.note: Q1 FY2027 6-K balance sheet. At 28-Feb-2026 the $828.2M comprised equity-method 19.7, equity securities at fair value 272.0, equity securities without readily determinable fair value 264.1 and ~272 of other long-term holdings; the Q1 FY2027 increase to $1,736.6M is ~$405M of fair-value gain (reported in other income) plus ~$500M rotated out of short-term investments. The income these assets generate (interest, fair-value gains) is excluded from the flows, so the asset belongs in the bridge (matching-asset rule). Mark risk: concentrated fair-valued stakes; a reversal of the Q1 gain would cost ~$0.72/ADS.

equity_bridge.item: Deferred tax liability on unrealised investment gains
equity_bridge.note: Q1 FY2027 6-K balance sheet deferred tax liabilities (68.0 at Feb-2026, +110.3 in the quarter against the $405M gain, ~27%, consistent with the 25% PRC rate). Deducted so the investments are carried net of the tax due on realisation.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case forward 5-year revenue CAGR (FY2026 3,009 to FY2031 5,500); historical CAGRs are unusable across the 2021 regulatory structural break
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Revenue 3-yr CAGR +43% vs 5-yr -8% and equity 5-yr -6%: the 2021 double-reduction ban destroyed 77% of revenue and the FY2023-FY2026 recovery is off that trough. Neither the equity CAGR (negative, distorted by $1.2B of FY2022 losses and $1.1B of buybacks) nor the revenue CAGR is a forward base; the owner-FCF series is negative in FY2023 (-103 reported, -212 after SBC) so its CAGR is undefined.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2024 193.4 - 88.9 - 84.9 = 19.6; FY2025 286.2 - 64.9 - 83.5 = 137.8; FY2026 508.3 - 43.1 - 62.0 = 403.2. SBC fell from 10.6% of revenue (FY2023) to 1.4% (FY2026) while owner FCF rose, so SBC is NOT absorbing the growth; interest income, by contrast, was 100% of owner FCF in FY2024 and is still 15% in FY2026, which is why it is stripped. Deferred-revenue inflows were 190.9 / 242.9 / 211.0 in FY2024/25/26, i.e. most of reported FCF in FY2024-25 and 41% in FY2026.

scenario_narratives.base: The post-pivot franchise (non-academic enrichment small classes, Xueersi learning devices and content, overseas) keeps compounding but decelerates fast: +24% in FY2027 on the Q1 run-rate, single digits by FY2030 and ~3% from FY2033 as the K-12 cohort shrinks with China's birth collapse. Operating leverage lifts the EBITDA margin from 13.0% (FY2026) to 16% in FY2027 and 19% at maturity. Cash tax ramps to the 25% PRC statutory rate; no NOL shelter is credited. The $2.9B of cash and short-term investments and $1.56B of long-term investments net of deferred tax are added to enterprise value; the interest and fair-value gains they produce are excluded from the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: Enrichment-tutoring demand per child and pricing power offset the shrinking cohort; learning devices hold share in a market crowded by ByteDance, Baidu and iFlytek; overseas and content lines scale; EBITDA margin reaches 23%, consistent with the 19.6% non-GAAP operating margin already printed in Q1 FY2027 plus D&A. Growth of 30%/22%/16% in FY2027-29 and 3% terminal, 16x cap.
scenario_narratives.bear: Beijing re-tightens: 'non-academic' enrichment is drawn into the double-reduction perimeter (licensing, fee and time caps) from FY2028, device margins are competed away, and the demographic cliff bites on schedule. Revenue peaks in FY2028 near $3.6B and settles near $3.3B; EBITDA margin 11%; deferred revenue unwinds. Terminal growth 1.5%, cap 12x. The cash and investment pile (~$7.90/ADS gross of the DTL) is most of the equity value in this path.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on the post-pivot business only, with SBC expensed and the share count held flat, interest and fair-value investment income stripped and their source assets added back in the bridge, growth decelerated hard against the demographic cliff, and the China regulatory axis carried in a 30% bear weight rather than in the discount rate. Roughly 40% of the weighted value is cash and investments; the market's ex-cash EV of ~$2.3B is about 5-6x FY2026 owner FCF, which is the regulatory discount being priced.
key_risks_to_valuation: Regulatory: a widening of the 2021 double-reduction perimeter to non-academic enrichment, learning devices or online content would reprice the operating franchise toward the bear case or below; TAL has no formal guidance and gives little disclosure of regulatory engagement.

Demographics: China births fell from 17.9M (2016) to ~9.0M (2023); the primary-school cohort shrinks sharply from ~2028. Every scenario decelerates for this, but the base case still assumes enrichment penetration and pricing partly offset it.

Investment marks: $1.74B of long-term investments (net $1.56B after DTL, ~$2.79/ADS) are largely fair-valued equity stakes; $405M of the carrying value is a single quarter's unrealised gain that can reverse.

Structure and listing: Cayman holdco with VIE contractual control of PRC operating entities, HFCAA/PCAOB exposure, capital controls on repatriating onshore cash; restricted tuition escrow ($306M) is excluded from net cash but a tightening of escrow rules could trap more.
Learning-device competition: Xueersi devices compete with ByteDance (Dali), Baidu, iFlytek and Youdao; product gross margins are lower than tutoring and the mix shift caps the mature EBITDA margin.

Seasonality and base effect: FY2027 is anchored on one quarter (+32%, 18% GAAP operating margin in the smallest revenue quarter); the full-year margin assumption of 16% could prove either conservative or, if summer marketing spend scales, generous.

Regulatory and demographic context from the 2021 PRC double-reduction opinion and NBS birth statistics.

inputs.share_count_basis: ADS-equivalents. 186.29M fully diluted Class A+B common shares at 31-May-2026 (184.40M outstanding by par-value method on the Q1 FY2027 balance sheet, 141k+49k par at $0.001 less 6k treasury, plus 1.89M dilutive awards = the quarter's 186,286,428 diluted weighted count) x 3 ADS per common share = 558.86M ADS. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would double-count. Buybacks of $644M in FY2026 and $40.7M (1.23M shares) between 23-Apr and 28-Jul-2026 fund the flat count; the ~0.9M shares bought after 31-May are ignored for consistency with the 31-May cash.
inputs.cash_note: Cash and cash equivalents 1,641.620 + short-term investments 1,232.945 at 31-May-2026 (Q1 FY2027 6-K, 30-Jul-2026). Restricted cash of 274.497 current + 31.538 non-current is EXCLUDED: it is tuition escrow required by PRC prepaid-tuition rules and backs deferred revenue, so it is customer money in substance. TAL carries no bank borrowings or bonds. Long-term investments are carried separately in equity_bridge (matching-asset rule).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 20-F cash flow statement share-based compensation add-back $43,093k (XBRL us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation). No PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation is tagged and the Q1 FY2027 6-K states the tax effect of SBC was immaterial, so no equity-award tax is added. Q1 FY2027 SBC was $11.5M (1.5% of revenue).
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2026 'Interest income, net' $62,030k per 20-F Item 5 (FY2025 83,482; FY2024 84,928). Stripped because net cash (2,875) is ~7x the owner-FCF base; the cash and investments that earn it sit in net_debt and equity_bridge. Fair-value gains on investments ($412M unrealised in FY2026, $405M in Q1 FY2027, reported in 'Other income, net') are non-cash and already outside OCF/FCF; they are NOT operating earnings and are excluded from every margin path.
inputs.wacc_rationale: 11.0% in USD, the reporting and quote currency (TAL reports in USD; underlying flows are RMB, translated). Build: USD 10-yr risk-free ~4.2%, mature-market ERP ~5.0%, beta ~1.2 for a consumer-discretionary education name, plus a China/VIE country-risk increment of ~1.5pp for Cayman-holdco/VIE structure, capital-control and HFCAA delisting exposure. All-equity capital structure (no debt), so WACC = cost of equity. The same 11% is used in all three scenarios: regulatory and demographic risk is charged in the scenario flows and weights, not a second time via per-scenario discount rates.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost, which is automatic under US GAAP ASC 842 for operating leases: the $131.5M FY2026 operating lease cost is inside operating expenses (so inside the EBITDA margin path) and the full cash payment is inside operating cash flow (so inside reported FCF). Operating lease liabilities of $405.5M (118.8 current + 286.7 non-current at 31-May-2026) are therefore EXCLUDED from net debt. lease_cost_pct_path is 0 because the charge is already in the margin, not because there are no leases.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests are -$0.8M (negative, immaterial) and NCI's share of profit was -$0.6M in FY2026; no adjustment made.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route (operating company: consumer-facing learning services and learning devices/content in China), scenario-weighted, 10-year horizon because margins are still ramping off the post-ban trough. Non-US adaptations read and applied: currency (USD/USD, fx 1.0), leases (treatment B), NCI (immaterial), excluded income / matching asset (interest income stripped; cash, ST and LT investments in the bridge), risk charged once (single WACC). STRUCTURAL BREAK: the 2021 'double reduction' policy banned K-9 academic after-school tutoring; revenue fell from $4.5B (FY2021) to $1.0B (FY2023) and the FY2017-FY2022 history is a different business. FY2023 onward (non-academic enrichment classes, Xueersi learning devices and content, overseas) is the operating base; FY2024/25/26 growth of +46%/+51%/+34% and Q1 FY2027 +32% is recovery off a regulatory trough and is decelerated hard in every scenario, because the addressable K-12 cohort shrinks sharply from ~2028 as China's 2017-2023 birth collapse (17.9M to 9.0M) reaches school age. ADS: 3 ADSs = 1 Class A common share (ratio since 16-Aug-2017); every per-share figure here is per ADS. EBITDA is GAAP operating income + depreciation + amortisation (FY2026: 276.0 + 68.6 + 3.8 = 348.5 before SBC add-back of 43.1 = 391.5, 13.0% of revenue); the $20.0M FY2026 long-lived asset impairment is left inside the margin. Q1 FY2027 (Mar-May 2026) is the FY2027 guidance anchor in the absence of formal guidance (TAL gives none): revenue +31.9%, GAAP operating margin 18.1%, non-GAAP 19.6%, deferred revenue $1,219M vs $882M at Feb-2026; FY2027 is modelled at +24% revenue and a 16% EBITDA margin for the full year, below the Q1 print because selling and marketing is seasonal and Q1 is the smallest revenue quarter. Cash tax: PRC statutory 25%; FY2026 ETR 22.5%, current tax 26% of operating pre-tax, cash paid 21%; a $571M valuation allowance sits on loss-entity NOLs that cannot shelter the profitable entities, so no NOL benefit is projected; the path ramps 23% to 25%. Working capital: deferred revenue (prepaid tuition) rose $211M in FY2026, 41% of reported FCF and 28% of the revenue increase, partly offset by inventory build in learning devices; modelled as capture on the revenue CHANGE, so the tailwind fades as growth decelerates and reverses in the bear case.

bear.narrative: Regulators extend double-reduction scrutiny to 'non-academic' enrichment (licensing caps, fee caps, time-slot bans) from FY2028, learning-device price competition compresses product margins, and the demographic cliff arrives on schedule: revenue peaks in FY2028 and drifts to ~$3.3B, EBITDA margin settles at 11%. The deferred-revenue tailwind reverses as enrolments fall (negative working capital on the revenue decline). Terminal cap 12x; the business survives on its cash pile but the operating franchise is worth little more than today's ex-cash EV.

base.narrative: FY2027 +24% (Q1 ran +32%, deferred revenue +38% YoY at May-2026), decelerating to 3% by FY2033 as the K-12 cohort shrinks; EBITDA margin 16% in FY2027 (vs 13.0% FY2026 and a seasonally strong 22% Q1), maturing at 19%, between TAL's pre-ban scale margins and the thinner learning-device mix. Cap 15x reflects a structurally slower, regulator-exposed business.

bull.narrative: Q1 FY2027's 32% growth and 19.6% non-GAAP operating margin persist through FY2028: enrichment-class penetration and pricing, Xueersi learning devices holding share against ByteDance/Baidu/iFlytek, overseas and content scaling, and operating leverage take the EBITDA margin to 23%. Regulatory stance stays tolerant of non-academic tutoring. Terminal growth 3% because enrichment demand per child rises even as the cohort shrinks.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30% because the whole business was banned once already (2021) and the thesis rests on a single regulator continuing to tolerate the pivot; bull cut from 35% to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right (regulatory tolerance, device share against much larger tech competitors, enrichment pricing power outrunning a 40% cohort decline). Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
